attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "Moves type-to-feature mapping population from per-shell ShellContainerFactory into the (likely singleton/globally-cached) ExtensionManager and removes GetExportedExtensionTypes from the public IExtensionManager interface, which is a breaking API change for external modules and could affect multi-tenant correctness if type-feature registration now only runs once instead of per-shell."}

reason: Moves type-to-feature mapping population from per-shell ShellContainerFactory into the (likely singleton/globally-cached) ExtensionManager and removes GetExportedExtensionTypes from the public IExtensionManager interface, which is a breaking API change for external modules and could affect multi-tenant correctness if type-feature registration now only runs once instead of per-shell.
